question: Which forms of Skanda are invoked to protect the hips and shanks?
premises: The spear-handed one is asked to protect the hips
The slayer of Tāraka is asked to protect the shanks
inference: The spear-handed one protects the hips and the slayer of Tāraka protects the shanks.
plain_english: May the spear-handed one protect my hips, and may the slayer of Tāraka protect my shanks.
